description.el:
Εμπλουτισμένη με GOLD QUInoA + ΠΡΩΤΕΪΝΗ, η επαγγελματική, ανατρεπτική χρυσαφένια σύνθεση της Serie Expert Resurfacing Golden Μάσκας επανορθώνει άμεσα κάθε τύπο μαλλιών εξασφαλίζοντας ανάλαφρο άγγιγμα. Η κρεμώδης Gel υφή της αφήνει τα μαλλιά 7x πιο λαμπερά* και πιο λεία, χωρίς να αφήνει κατάλοιπα στην τρίχα.

L'Oréal Professionnel, 14, rue Royale - 75008 Paris France, consumercaregreece@loreal.com
description.en: Absolut Repair Golden Instant resurfacing mask offers the ultimate professional deep repair experience for damaged and dry hair while ensuring lightness. The results are proven: it instantly restores all hair types with a lightweight touch, resulting in 99%* less fiber surface damage. The hair is manageable and 2X** shinier. The fiber is strengthened and restored thanks to the powerful ingredients Omega-9 and protein. This luxurious lightweight mask has a silky golden texture, which envelopes your damaged hair with care without leaving any residue. For an optimum anti-damage repair result, apply the three step Absolut Repair haircare routine including the cleansing and nourishing shampoo, the repairing mask and the 10-in-1 multi purpose leave in spray.​ *Combing damage. Instrumental test after Gold Mask Absolut repair **Instrumental test after Gold Mask Absolut Repair

howTo.el:
Εφαρμόστε σε ταμποναρισμένα μαλλιά και αφήστε για 3- 5 λεπτά προτού ξεβγάλετε πολύ καλά, 1- 2 φορές την εβδομάδα.

Σε περίπτωση επαφής με τα μάτια, ξεπλύνετε αμέσως.
howTo.en: After Absolut Repair Shampoo, apply to towel-dried hair. Leave in for 3 to 5 minutes. Rinse thoroughly.

safety.en: In case of contact with eyes, rinse them immediately and thoroughly.
